# Alan Maclean

Alan Maclean is a former States Member, first elected to the States of Jersey in 2005.

Alan Maclean has participated in 3 elections since 2002:

- [**2005 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/alan-maclean#e7)

  Elected as Deputy of St Helier No 2 with 36.8% of the ballot.
- [**2008 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/alan-maclean#e10)

  Elected as Senator with 37.4% of the ballot.

  - [2008 Full Manifesto](http://jerseyelections.info/senators/alan-maclean.html)
- [**2014 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/alan-maclean#e19)

  Elected as Senator with 46.9% of the ballot.

  - [2014 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2014/alan-maclean/)
  - [2014 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20141218204835/http://alanmaclean.je/page/652320-manifesto.aspx)
  - [2014 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z5qOQEuV7Js)

Alan Maclean has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Senators Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/17/former-treasury-minister-seeks-states-return/)\]
